## Tasks: governance — v2 (floor + audit + golden path)

**Slice/PR plan (feature-branch-chain):**
- S1 gov/s1-foundation → feature/governance: ~110 lines ✅ Done
- S2 gov/s2-hard-gates → gov/s1-foundation: ~150 lines ✅ Done
- S3 gov/s3-protect → gov/s2-hard-gates: ~260 lines (16 tasks, 3 operator)
- S4 gov/s4-floor → gov/s3-protect: ~200 lines (11 tasks, 2 operator) — split to S4a/S4b if >350 lines
- S5 gov/s5-golden-path → gov/s4-floor: ~120 lines (9 tasks, 1 operator)

**Review Workload Forecast:**
- Total estimated: ~840 lines across 5 PRs
- 400-line budget risk: Medium (S3 and S4 each approach budget; S4 split signal: >350 lines → split to checks-lib + hooks-audit)
- Decision needed: No (all slices within budget at current estimates)

**S3 tasks (16 total, 3 operator):**
S3.1/S3.2 governance-checks.mjs (drift-guard + checkContexts); S3.3/S3.4 protectBranch returns {enforced,reason,remedy}; S3.5/S3.6 capabilities() probe; S3.7 gitlab stub; S3.8 brain-protect.mjs; S3.9 brain-governance-status.mjs; S3.10 package.json scripts; S3.11 vcs-contract.md; S3.12 workflow-governance.md; S3.13 bootstrap.sh env:init; S3.14 npm test green; S3.15 i18n-branch coordination; S3.16 activation.

**S4 tasks (11 total, 2 operator):**
S4.1-S4.4 RED tests for 4 check modules; S4.5 GREEN — create scripts/governance/checks/{diff-size,issue-link,adr-presence,memory-presence}.mjs; S4.6 commit-msg hook (new); S4.7 pre-commit hook (new); S4.8 extend pre-push to wire 4 checks; S4.9 brain-audit.mjs + test (git fixture); S4.10 npm test green; S4.11 manual hook verification.
NOTE: S4 does NOT add memory-gate/decision-gate as CI jobs — that was v1-S4. Checks move to hooks + audit.

**S5 tasks (9 total, 1 operator):**
S5.1 brain-start.mjs + test; S5.2 brain-check.mjs + test; S5.3 brain-save.mjs + test; S5.4 brain-ship.mjs + test; S5.5 brain-next.mjs + test (state machine); S5.6 --no-verify in check-config + unit test; S5.7 harness PreToolUse hook config; S5.8 npm test green; S5.9 manual E2E checklist.

**Where:** openspec/changes/governance/tasks.md
